map.家具布局按矩形包围盒核算：空间利用率 = 房内家具投影面积之和 ÷ 房间面积 ×: Furniture layout uses bounding boxes: space utilization = sum of in-room furniture footprint ÷ room area × 100%, recommended 40%–60%; overlap area reveals furniture pressing on each other, outside-room area reveals items extending beyond the room. Main passage ≥60 cm, bedside 60-75 cm, sofa-to-table 40-50 cm and dining clearance 75-90 cm are manual reference values; this tool does not compute passage clear width, door swing radius or actual circulation.
map.装修前在户型图上预摆床、沙发、餐桌，检查家具是否超出房间、是否互相重叠；主通道净: Before renovation, pre-place the bed, sofa and dining table on the plan and check whether items extend beyond the room or overlap; verify main passage ≥60 cm and bedside ≥50 cm with a tape measure on site — this tool does not detect them automatically.
map.卧室面积 3.6×3.0=10.8㎡，双人床 1.8×2.0 占 3.6㎡（约: Bedroom 3.6×3.0=10.8 m², double bed 1.8×2.0 occupies 3.6 m² (about 33%); leave 0.5 m aisles and 0.7 m at the foot, room remains for two 0.5×0.4 bedside cabinets and a 1.2 m wardrobe. The 0.5 m passage must be checked with a tape on site; the tool computes occupancy, in-room overlap and outside-room area, giving "outside room or not + occupancy", not passage or door detection.
map.成人通行主通道 ≥60cm，床侧下地 ≥50cm，轮椅 / 搬运 ≥90cm；小: Adult main passage ≥60 cm, bedside clearance ≥50 cm, wheelchair/moving ≥90 cm; below 50 cm is tight. These are manual reference values; this tool does not compute passage clearance or warn about tightness.
